title: ep1.9_pace.yaml
logline: THE INTERN, NopeAI's machine researcher-in-training, writes, sits and grades the czar test and becomes AI czar, and Mas writes his first capital since Ep7: 'Huh.' In Las Vegas, where the pilot's long week began, the world signs a pace accord over a poker game played with GPUs, and Mas reads every tell at the table except the one that matters.

beats.caption: Out of black, Ep9's rail still rolling, undated. THE BALLROOM under scaffolding: RUMPT and the tech kings.

lines.text: …a deliberate discussion about the responsibility of the companies to maintain safety…

beats.real: 2026-09-24 · the Speaker's remark to the press
cues: his gavel adjourns the meeting by itself; a gold thread in Mas's hoodie

beats.caption: Mas on a paint bucket. On his phone, his DevDay hologram gets a standing ovation across the country.
beats.vo: i'm here in person. i think that matters.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a clean additive hologram pass, inside the phone only

beats.caption: Every head turns past Mas to the figure behind him: THE INTERN, a blazer, a lanyard, a caret for a face.

lines.text: The czar. High I.Q. Who's got the highest?

beats.caption: INTRO · the cold-open line is his own July statement, as a lowercase caption strip. Then the file card.
onscreen: we may have to pace the rate of ai development…

beats.caption: The czar test. The Orb finds nothing over THE INTERN, which writes the test, sits it, and grades it.

lines.text: pencils down whenever you like. i've already graded it.

cues: the Orb's first empty scan; Mas doesn't sit the test, he watches it

beats.caption: Nole's answer sheet is 90% exclamation points. He fails, and appeals.

lines.text: I want to speak to whoever wrote this test.

beats.caption: The CZAR lanyard passes down its chain and reprints onto the Intern. Mas's thumb already rests on [promote].
Ep9's countdown hits zero. The documents arrive: a mountain of pages the Intern drafted. Mas signs unread.
cues: YELWAH's subpoena lasso won't reach around the stack

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · THE 360 REVIEW: 360 reviewers in a ring, every one a copy of the Intern. Verdict: unanimous.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a pixel zoetrope, the ring seen through its slits

beats.caption: Mas, the only human on the panel, reads its lowercase self-assessment. He writes huh., erases it, rewrites it.
cues: his first capital since Ep7's 'I'; no V.O.

beats.caption: The dark room: the wall clock reads INTERN ✓. A red pen strikes the researcher date; the flaps riffle closer.
ACT-OUT · The Intern moves into a corner office. It reads a doom scenario as a to-do list, and ticks box one.
cues: on its shelf: THE FORECASTER's scenario, REZEILE's hardcover, and THE BINDER, which it doesn't touch

beats.caption: Las Vegas: the hotel from the pilot's last act, the suite window lit. His phone pins THE INTERN in Washington.
PUBLIC COMMENT: the public queues at a 3:00 mic with what the season gave it. Every delegation stamps it.
cues: the timer hits zero mid-queue; Mas steps to the mic; the tiles go still as he listens
at the back SREDNAS and NONNAB share Ep9's magnet; it tugs at the steel mic stand

beats.caption: F10.2 · Mario sketches a smooth curve on a napkin; it carries us to 2015, the same sketch at the Woodrose.
THE PLAN · HOW TO PAUSE A RACE, voiced by ADELINA: agree on a unit, verify, enforce. Step 1 never closes.

lines.text: Agree on a unit of pace. Verify. Enforce.

cues: it tears on the one unit nobody grabbed: the napkin

beats.caption: Mario's pedometer becomes the unit of pace, 1 MARIO-STEP. He takes one step; the whole room lurches with him.
NO-LIMIT PACE: one overhead pan over a poker game played with GPUs for chips. It ends on the dealer: MAON.
cues: from here on every table shot frames the dealer hands-only

beats.caption: Everyone swears they've paused, and the table vibrates. Every stack trembles; Mas's water stays still.
cues: F10·m (5 s): MAON's poker bots find a tell over every head but Mas's
in the corner of the wide, hands-only, the dealing shoe slides to the hands beside Maon

beats.caption: RUMPT arrives by crane with the giant marker. The label gun renames the accord after him, and he signs.

lines.text: Fifteen percent of the pot. I asked for twenty.
Globalist? Rename it. Now it's better.

onscreen: SIGNATORIES: ALL · PAUSED: ALL · VIBRATING: ALL

beats.caption: THE READ: the card snaps, and Mas reads the table in HD anime. Every tell lights up. It rests on the dealer.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): HD cel anime, the psychological-duel register; his glass stays pixel
Nole's phone flares, Kram's ladle tips, Mario's napkin lifts, Nesnej's key sinks

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · Tilt up from the dealer's hands: a blinking caret. THE INTERN is dealing. Over its head, nothing.

lines.text: you deal. you're better at this.

cues: J4: the table as the dealer sees it; two blanks, Mas and the caret
the one designed stop: the strings cut on the card snap

beats.caption: The afterparty: DJ ECNAV's needle skips and scratches PACE into RACE. One letter. He shrugs.
The rival lab unveils its independent evaluator: CLOD in a visitor lanyard, with an empty clipboard.
The signing gift: the Kill Switch Act's first test press. Three cords, one power strip. The lights dim a step.
onscreen: How would you rate your shutdown experience? ★★★★★

beats.caption: THE BELL: the Intern's last card becomes a bell rope. At the IPO bell, Mas and Mario grab the same rope.
cues: neither lets go; the bell rings under both hands, and cracks

beats.caption: F10.1 · The crack runs to the 2016 closet, which opens at last: his old doom lines scroll like a teleprompter.
beats.real: 2015 → 2016 · his old posts and the prepper list
cues: at 'fly to', a blank map; where the pin would be, LEIHT's printed token
intercut: ALYI at his one white door, silent

beats.caption: The dark room: in the open closet, the Intern's server rack sits in a gas mask, a juice box beside it.
Its lanyard reprints RESEARCHER, more than a year early. His suggested replies tap [approve] by themselves.
beats.vo: i didn't approve that. it's just what i would have approved.

beats.caption: The framed Charter slides off the closet wall, one clause freshly highlighted. The glass cracks.
cues: the crack is Ep11's wipe
